title: WeddingEvent
description: One event of a wedding (issue #29): the ceremony, the reception, a rehearsal dinner. Guests answer an RSVP per event. Owned by one tenant and one wedding; stored under groupedKey(wedding_id, event_id) and read one wedding at a time.

event_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

wedding_id.description: The wedding the event belongs to.

starts_at.description: The local date and time the event starts (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, no zone: the time on the invitation, where the event is).

location.description: Where it happens (free text), when known.

invitation.description: Who is invited when a guest has no RSVP record for this event: every guest, or only the guests marked invited (an invite-only rehearsal dinner). A plus-one without a record follows their host.

meal_options.description: The meals a guest can choose at this event; empty when there is no meal choice. At most 8 (enforced by the event service: a maxItems here would generate a tuple type).

option_id.description: Stable across label edits (an edit that names the option_id renames it in place), so a guest's choice survives a renamed meal.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last edit, when edited.
